My boyfriend at the time and I decided to do mushrooms together at home, around 2.5g each. He had also bought some ketamine and suggested we add a little bit at the peak to 'deepen' it. I'd never done ketamine and I was nervous but went along with it. The mushrooms came on strong and it was nice for a while, we were lying on the floor listening to music. Then he gave me a bump of ketamine, I don't know how much.

Within a few minutes I couldn't feel my body anymore. I tried to lift my hand and nothing happened. The room started to stretch and pull away, like I was falling backwards down a very long tunnel. I could hear the music but it was coming from very far away and getting slower. I tried to say his name and I couldn't. I was completely trapped inside my head, and I became convinced I'd had a stroke and was paralysed forever. Then even that thought dissolved and there was just this grey, buzzing nothing.

When I started to come back, maybe 30-40 minutes later, I could see again, but I couldn't move properly. He wasn't in the room. I heard him in the kitchen on the phone, laughing. I called out and he came in and said I was 'tripping balls' and that it looked funny. Then he went back to the kitchen. I was lying there alone, half-paralysed, still on mushrooms, feeling completely abandoned and terrified. I crawled to the bathroom and locked the door and sat in the dark for hours. Every time he knocked I felt afraid of him, which I'd never felt before. I thought he had done this to me on purpose. The rest of the night is a blur. I remember thinking I would never trust anyone again.

Ich habe in den Niederlanden an einer Ayahuasca-Zeremonie teilgenommen, eigentlich um meine Depression zu behandeln. Nach dem zweiten Becher musste ich mich heftig übergeben, und dann kamen Bilder, die ich nicht erwartet hatte. Ich sah mich als kleines Kind im Haus meines Onkels, und plötzlich waren da Erinnerungen an Dinge, die er mit mir gemacht hat. Ich hatte das vollkommen vergessen, oder verdrängt. Es war, als würde ich es noch einmal erleben, mit allen Gefühlen und Gerüchen. Ich habe geschrien und mich zusammengerollt. Die Leiterin der Zeremonie hat mich gehalten, aber ich konnte nicht unterscheiden, ob sie es ist oder er. Ich wollte, dass es aufhört, aber es hörte nicht auf.
Took too much acid at a house party and thought I had died. Very scared, couldn't calm down.

I want to start by saying that I was experienced with psychedelics, I'd done mushrooms maybe 15 times, and I thought I knew what I was doing. That arrogance is part of the story.

It was October and I decided to go on a solo hike in a national park and take a large dose of mushrooms, around 5 grams, at a spot I'd been to before, a viewpoint about two hours' walk from the car park. My plan was to sit there for the peak and walk back in the afternoon. I told nobody where I was going. My father had died that summer and I wanted to 'connect' with him and with nature.

I took the mushrooms around 11am. The come-up was very fast and strong. Within 40 minutes I couldn't stand properly. The landscape started to breathe and pulse, and the trees looked like they were made of light. For a while it was overwhelming but beautiful. Then I saw my father. Not like a hallucination exactly, but I knew he was there, sitting on a rock nearby. He looked sick, the way he looked in the hospital at the end. He didn't say anything. He just looked at me with this terrible sadness. I started to cry and I tried to go to him and I fell down a small slope and hurt my ankle.

After that, everything turned. The light was going (I didn't realise how late it was, I'd lost all sense of time), and the trees around me became threatening. I heard voices in the wind, and I felt that the forest was angry that I was there. I started to believe I was going to die there, that my father had come to take me with him. Then I lost the sense of being a person at all. I was just fear, spread across the whole forest. I don't know how long this lasted.

When I became somewhat aware again it was dark. I was cold, my ankle was swollen and I was still tripping. My phone had almost no battery and no signal. I tried to walk back but I couldn't find the trail. I kept hearing things moving in the bushes, and every shadow looked like a figure. I sat down under a tree and wrapped myself in my rain jacket and shook all night. I was convinced I would freeze to death, and part of me thought I deserved it for not being there more for my dad.

At first light I started walking and eventually found a forest road. A ranger in a truck picked me up around 9am. I was hypothermic and had a sprained ankle, and I spent a night in a small hospital. The doctors were kind, but I was too ashamed to tell them about the mushrooms at first. When I finally told my sister what had happened, she cried and said she could have lost two family members in one year.

Wir waren auf einer Party und hatten alle LSD genommen. Ein Freund von mir ist plötzlich zusammengebrochen, hat gekrampft und nicht mehr reagiert. Ich war die Einzige, die noch halbwegs klar war, und musste den Krankenwagen rufen. Ich hatte panische Angst, dass er stirbt, und gleichzeitig war alles verzerrt und unwirklich.

I signed up for a weekend psilocybin retreat that was advertised as safe and trauma-informed. There were about 15 participants and two facilitators. In the opening circle, the lead facilitator talked a lot about 'surrender' and said that the medicine sometimes brings up resistance, and that it's our job to stay with it no matter what. I didn't think much of it at the time.

The dose was high, they didn't tell us exactly how much. About an hour in I started to feel very anxious and wanted to sit up and open my eyes. One of the facilitators came over and gently but firmly pushed me back down and told me to keep my eyeshades on and surrender. I said I wanted to go outside for a moment and she said no, that leaving the space would 'break the container'. I felt trapped. I couldn't think clearly enough to argue.

Then the visions became very dark. I saw myself in a cage, and the bars were made of the facilitators' voices. I felt my identity crumbling, I didn't know who I was or why I was there. I kept trying to sit up and kept being told to lie down. At one point I was crying and shaking and the lead facilitator sat next to me and put his hand on my chest and said that what I was feeling was old trauma leaving my body. I didn't want him to touch me. I felt like I wasn't allowed to say no.

Later in the session I heard other people screaming and crying too, and there was drumming that felt like it was getting louder and louder. I felt like I was in some kind of cult. When it ended I was completely exhausted and confused. In the closing circle we were all supposed to share our 'breakthroughs', and I said I felt good because I was afraid of what would happen if I didn't.

I took MDMA and LSD together at a club. I got very hot, my heart was pounding and I felt like I was going to pass out. My friends took me outside, but I got worse and started shaking and feeling like I was dying. Someone called an ambulance and I ended up in the ER with a temperature of 40 degrees. The whole time the LSD made everything feel like a nightmare I couldn't wake up from, with the paramedics' faces melting.

Wir waren im Urlaub in Portugal, meine Freundin und ich, und haben auf einer Klippe am Meer Pilze genommen. Zuerst war alles wunderschön, das Meer glitzerte und ich fühlte mich ihr sehr nahe. Dann hat sich etwas verschoben. Ich sah sie an und wusste plötzlich nicht mehr, wer sie ist. Ihr Gesicht war mir völlig fremd. Ich hatte das Gefühl, dass ich in einer Art Theaterstück bin, in dem alle Rollen spielen und nur ich nicht weiß, worum es geht. Ich habe sie immer wieder gefragt, ob sie echt ist, und sie hat versucht, mich zu beruhigen, aber ihre Worte kamen bei mir nicht an. Dann fing die Zeit an, sich zu wiederholen. Ich habe dieselben Wellen, dieselben Möwen, dieselben Sätze immer und immer wieder erlebt. Ich hatte panische Angst, dass ich verrückt geworden bin und dass das nie mehr aufhört. Ich wollte nur noch weg von der Klippe, weil ich Angst hatte, dass ich springe, nicht weil ich sterben wollte, sondern um die Schleife zu durchbrechen. Meine Freundin hat mich am Arm genommen und zurück zum Auto geführt. Erst Stunden später im Hotel hat die Schleife langsam aufgehört.

It was a regular LSD trip at home, about 150ug, with my wife sitting for me. We'd done this before. A couple of hours in I had a thought that she was looking at her phone too much, and then the thought grew: she's texting someone, she's having an affair, she's been planning to leave me. I knew on some level it was ridiculous but I couldn't stop it. I started analysing everything she did, the way she smiled, the way she moved, and everything looked like evidence. Then came a different kind of thought, a horrible intrusive image of me hurting her. I was terrified, because I love her and I'd never do that, but the image kept coming back, more and more vivid, and I started to believe that the fact I was thinking it meant I was a dangerous person, that the LSD had revealed my true self. I locked myself in the bedroom so I couldn't hurt her. I was crying and hitting my head against the wall trying to make the thoughts stop. She was knocking on the door, crying too, and that made it worse because I thought I was ruining her life. I stayed in that room for six hours. When I came out, I couldn't look her in the eyes. I felt like a monster.
I've never told anyone except my therapist about the images. It's the first time I'm writing it down.
Ich war auf Pilzen in einer Gruppe, plötzlich habe ich nur noch Dämonen gesehen und konnte nicht mehr unterscheiden, was echt ist.

I took ibogaine at a clinic in Mexico to detox from opioids after 8 years of addiction. I knew it would be hard but nothing prepared me for it. The visions lasted about 20 hours. I saw my whole life replayed, every lie I told, every person I stole from, my mother crying in the kitchen. I saw my own funeral. I couldn't move and I vomited many times. At one point my heart rhythm went irregular and the doctor gave me something through the IV, and I heard them talking about it and was sure I was dying. The second day was a grey state of no sleep and endless thinking. It was the worst and most important thing I've ever done.

Ich habe bei einer Zeremonie in Spanien San Pedro getrunken. Nach etwa zwei Stunden wurde mir extrem übel, und ich hatte das Gefühl, vergiftet worden zu sein. Mein Körper fühlte sich schwer und fremd an, mein Herz raste. Die Leiterin sagte, das sei normal, aber ich war mir sicher, dass ich sterbe. Ich lag stundenlang in der Sonne, unfähig mich zu bewegen, und hatte Todesangst. Später habe ich mich übergeben, aber die Panik ging nicht weg.
